description: Process explicitly supplied raw source text through the configured Knowl AI pipeline. Use only for an explicit ingestion request; never silently ingest the current conversation or prompt.

autoResolve.description: Whether to auto-resolve contradictions by superseding old knowledge (defaults to false).

commitMessage.description: Optional human-readable description for the knowledge commit.

namespace.description: Store to write to. Use project (the default) unless the user asks for global; global is the machine-wide personal store, used automatically when no project is open.

profile.description: What kind of knowledge this text is, so the right filter applies: code (software work), general (personal and everyday), academic (sources, claims, research), or a profile the user added. Choose by content; for mixed text, call once per kind with the matching part. Omit to use the store default.

text.description: The raw text or conversation log to ingest.

name: knowl_ingest
